Parse the serving CSV, not server logs. When the response streams, ttft_ms is the time to the first token and tpot_ms is (e2e - ttft) / (output tokens - 1). A non-streaming response leaves ttft_ms blank. p50, p95, and p99 are percentiles of the completed requests. The summary row copies the p50 into e2e_ms, ttft_ms, and tpot_ms
